budget_items.topic: Irrigation meter readings charge from Water District
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Water Commission voted to charge the Sewer Commission a yearly fee for irrigation meter readings: a lower rate for the first two years and a higher rate thereafter.
budget_items.quote: charge the sewer commission $ 500/year for the first 2 years and $ 750/year thereafter, for irrigation meter readings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Water District did not expect up-front costs, but said the Sewer Commission would pay any that arise.
budget_items.quote: the water district didn't think there will be any up-front costs but if there are, the sewer commission would pay them.

budget_items.topic: Connection fees and permit to connect
